text: Columbia papers means all in-scope OpenAlex works (all work types), both citing and cited published in 2021–2024. Count each directed citing–cited work pair once, including author self-citations if present. Use the OpenAlex field of each work's single primary topic, with Unclassified for missing fields. Direction runs from citing field to cited field.

The Sankey ranks named fields by total citing plus cited citation endpoints in the chosen flow mode, shows an adjustable number of leading fields, and combines the rest as Other fields without dropping their flows. Unclassified stays separate. Same/different colors are computed before grouping; the cross-field mode excludes unclassified pairs.
